arguments.value: Gary A. Fenner, born in 1947 in St. Joseph, Missouri, is a senior United States district judge for the Western District of Missouri. He received a B.A. from the University of Kansas in 1970 and a J.D. from the University of Missouri-Kansas City School of Law in 1973. He began his legal career in private practice in Platte City, Missouri, in 1973, served as assistant city attorney in St. Joseph from 1973 to 1977, and was a business law instructor at Webster College from 1976 to 1977. He returned to private practice in St. Joseph from 1977 to 1979, then served as judge of the Circuit Court of Missouri, Fifth Judicial Circuit, from 1979 to 1987, and later as judge of the Missouri Court of Appeals, Western District, from 1988 to 1996, including as chief judge from 1994 to 1996. He was nominated to the federal bench by President Bill Clinton on December 13, 1995, confirmed by the Senate on July 10, 1996, and received his commission on July 25, 1996.
